// @path: src/lib/ops/reads.ts
// @expect: OPS-MODEL-METHOD
import "server-only";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";

// A parents'-evening APPOINTMENT is CREDENTIAL_NEVER: booked, it names a child,
// their family and the member of staff they are seeing, at a stated time. An
// operator cannot know which rows are empty without reading rows, so the table
// is refused whole — a count included. The EVENT is school text and is
// ADULT_READABLE; this is not the event.
export async function bookedSlots() {
  return db.meetingSlot.count({ where: { bookedAt: { not: null } } });
}
